units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:12">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> <he>הריני צר את כל קטורין וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) I will shape his features in resemblance to &c.; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 24:1">Pesik. R. s. 24</cite> <he>בלקטרים</he>, <he>בלקטירים</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 24:1">Ib.</cite> <he>יושב וצר בל׳ וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) was painting the picture of the ruler (Lev. R. l. c. <cite ref="A01596"><he>איקונין</he></cite>). [Ar. s. v. <he>קנכתר</he>: <he>קנכתירין</he>.]—V. also <cite ref="K00284"><he>כּוֹלֶּקְטָר</he></cite>.
